init_SUNRGBDDataset: create a SUNRGBDDataset instance with data_root, ann_file, and optional pipeline for 3D detection experiments
get_ann_info_SUNRGBDDataset: get annotation info including 3D ground truth bboxes and labels by index from SUNRGBDDataset
show_SUNRGBDDataset: visualize 3D bounding box prediction results with ground truth on point clouds to output directory
review_SUNRGBDDataset_CLASSES: review the SUNRGBDDataset CLASSES tuple containing 10 indoor object categories like bed, table, and sofa
refactor_SUNRGBDDataset_box_type: refactor SUNRGBDDataset to switch box_type_3d between Depth, LiDAR, or Camera coordinate systems
